title: Email address
description: A valid internationalized email address, as defined by IETF RFC 5322, RFC 6530, and other RFCs. Note: Due to RFC 5321, an email address can be up to 254 character long – even though up to 64 characters are allowed before the @ sign, and 255 characters are allowed after the @ sign. It is practically impossible to define a single regular expression that can validate all possible international email address formats. Therefore, this pattern verifies only that the string contains an unquoted @ sign.
